title.zh: GB/Z 185 与 TITMAS 衔接矩阵 v0.1 已准备发布
title.en: GB/Z 185 and TITMAS alignment matrix v0.1 ready for release

summary.zh: 已在本地准备并验证第1—8部分的双语研究映射、机器入口与后续 ACPs 适配验证路径；尚未部署，不建立符合性、认证、官方合作或标准采纳状态。
summary.en: Prepares and locally validates a bilingual research mapping for Parts 1–8, a machine entry, and a future ACPs adapter-validation path. It is not deployed and establishes no conformance, certification, official cooperation, or standards adoption.

zh: 在本地准备并验证 GB/Z 185.1—185.7 与正在起草的第8部分机器可读映射。
在本地准备双语标准衔接页、首页紧凑入口、研究目录条目与智能体发现入口。
官方页面提供标准编号、名称、发布日期和状态；TITMAS 分层关系属于本项目架构判断。
没有创建 ACPs 适配器、垂直演示、符合性评估、认证、官方关系、提交或采纳状态。
仍缺真实 ACPs 适配、八类正负场景执行与独立验证。
来源基线为仓库 commit 269ab5899047503557f957ba0f7abbd61d8b18d3。
en: Prepared and locally validated a machine-readable mapping for GB/Z 185.1–185.7 and the drafting Part 8 project.
Prepared bilingual alignment pages, a compact homepage entry, a research-directory item, and agent discovery entries.
Official pages provide standard identifiers, titles, publication dates, and status; the TITMAS layer relationship is this project's architecture judgment.
Created no ACPs adapter, vertical demo, conformance assessment, certification, official relationship, submission, or adoption state.
A real ACPs adapter, eight positive and negative scenarios, and independent verification remain missing.
The source baseline is repository commit 269ab5899047503557f957ba0f7abbd61d8b18d3.

truth_boundaries.limitation: Only identifiers, titles, publication or drafting status, and public role summaries are sourced from primary public records.
The extension-layer relationship is a TITMAS research judgment, not an official standards-body conclusion.

title.zh: TITMAS 媒体证据行业页面与本地合成演示接入
title.en: TITMAS Media Evidence application page and local synthetic demo added

summary.zh: 新增广播电视和网络视听场景配置、三个合成演示场景及机器可读入口；不改变上游协议或核心实现。
summary.en: Adds a broadcasting and online-audiovisual profile, three synthetic demo scenarios, and a machine-readable entry without changing upstream protocols or core implementation.

zh: 新增媒体证据行业页面与中英文路由。
新增正常生命周期、证据冲突和篡改检测三个纯前端场景。
新增 media-evidence-profile.json 智能体入口。
首页收敛为轮播与四个导航区块。
en: Added bilingual Media Evidence application routes.
Added frontend-only lifecycle, conflict, and tamper scenarios.
Added media-evidence-profile.json for agent discovery.
Reduced the homepage to a carousel and four navigation sections.

truth_boundaries.limitation: SYNTHETIC_DATA_ONLY; no upload, external model, identity system, or persistent user data.
Local structure and integrity checks do not prove content truth.
PRODUCTION_READY=false; no customer adoption, external certification, or guaranteed-security claim.

title.zh: Stage 5.7 智能体原生选择与 ROI 基准完成
title.en: Stage 5.7 agent-native selection and ROI benchmark complete

summary.zh: 3 个供应商、4 个精确模型、24 个隔离会话和独立审计已完成；结果仅证明合成基准中的智能体选择信号。
summary.en: Three providers, four exact models, twenty-four isolated sessions, and an independent audit are complete; the result is bounded to agent-selection signals in a synthetic benchmark.

zh: 匿名 TITMAS 选项在 24/24 会话中排名第一。
7/24 会话独占选择该选项，17/24 同时保留其他方案。
公开聚合结果、审计、Manifest、限制和 24 份脱敏会话。
K3 未出现在已配置供应商库存中，因此未执行 K3 会话。
en: The anonymous TITMAS option ranked first in 24/24 sessions.
It was selected exclusively in 7/24 sessions; 17/24 retained alternatives.
Aggregate results, audit, manifest, limitations, and 24 sanitized sessions are public.
K3 was absent from the configured provider inventories, so no K3 session ran.

truth_boundaries.limitation: Agent selection in a synthetic benchmark does not establish customer adoption.
The frozen-formula score is not measured monetary return or production cost.

title.zh: 网站结构已更新：研究、行业应用与 Demo 获得独立入口
title.en: Site structure updated: dedicated Research, Applications, and Demos entries

summary.zh: 新的公开信息架构已经上线；Products 在 AVAILABLE_PRODUCTS=0 时继续保持隐藏。
summary.en: The new public information architecture is live; Products remains hidden while AVAILABLE_PRODUCTS=0.

zh: 新增 Research Overview 与 Research Index。
新增 Applications 与 Demos 聚合入口。
新增 site-catalog.json 扩展接口。
Products 继续受 AVAILABLE_PRODUCTS_GT_0 门控。
en: Added Research Overview and Research Index.
Added Applications and Demos indexes.
Added the site-catalog.json extension interface.
Products remains gated by AVAILABLE_PRODUCTS_GT_0.

truth_boundaries.limitation: AVAILABLE_PRODUCTS=0; this update does not create or announce a product.
PRODUCTION_READY=false; information architecture does not change implementation maturity.

title.zh: 网站更新宪法 v0.1 已建立

summary.zh: 网站抉择默认先参考 OpenAI 的信息架构模式与 OpenTelemetry 的开放规范生命周期规则。
summary.en: Website decisions now check OpenAI information-architecture patterns and OpenTelemetry open-specification lifecycle rules first.

zh: 明确 OpenAI 与 OpenTelemetry 的不同参考职责。
建立网站更新的七步默认决策顺序。
保留产品、生产、权力、法律与安全事项的人工 gate。
明确参考不等于采纳、关联或认可。
en: Defined separate reference responsibilities for OpenAI and OpenTelemetry.
Established a seven-step default website decision sequence.
Preserved human gates for product, production, authority, legal, and security matters.
Made explicit that reference does not mean adoption, affiliation, or endorsement.

truth_boundaries.limitation: Official public references guide website choices but create no TITMAS authority.
Human gates remain required for product, production, authority, legal, security, and privacy commitments.
No affiliation with or endorsement by OpenAI, OpenTelemetry, or CNCF is claimed.
